title: Psy-Chronicle: Synthesizing Campus Counseling Grounded in a Student's Semester Timeline
abstract: arXiv:2605.22140v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Psychological counseling unfolds over many sessions, and what a client brings to each session depends on what has happened in their life since the last one. Existing synthetic counseling corpora are mostly single-session, and multi-session ones advance along a therapy plan without modeling the client's life between sessions. We present Psy-Chronicle, an event-driven framework that grounds multi-session counseling synthesis in a student's semester timeline: each simulated student receives a profile and a semester-long temporal stress event graph, and counseling sessions are generated along this timeline with memory carried across them. Applied to campus counseling, it yields CPCD, an open Chinese dataset of 100 students and 1{,}248 sessions spanning a full semester. translated_title: Psy-Chronicle：基于学生学期时间线的校园心理咨询对话合成
translated_abstract: 心理咨询通常跨越多次会谈展开，来访者在每次会谈中所谈论的内容，取决于自上次会谈以来其生活中发生的事情。现有的合成心理咨询语料库大多为单次会谈，而多会话语料库则沿着既定的治疗方案推进，并未对来访者两次会谈之间的生活进行建模。我们提出了 Psy-Chronicle，这是一个事件驱动的框架，将多轮心理咨询对话的合成建立在学生的学期时间线之上：每个模拟学生都拥有一个个人档案和一个覆盖整个学期的时间性压力事件图，心理咨询会谈沿着这一时间线生成，并在各次会谈之间保留记忆。将该框架应用于校园心理咨询场景，我们构建了 CPCD——一个开放的中文数据集，包含 100 名学生和 1,248 次跨越整个学期的会谈。对话严格遵循各自的时间线：事件之间的依赖关系能够跨越会谈延续，且对先前会谈的回指很少引入时间线轨迹中不存在的内容。
tldr: Psy-Chronicle 提出一个事件驱动的多轮心理咨询对话合成框架，以模拟学生的学期时间线和压力事件图为根基生成跨会话携带记忆的对话，并据此构建了包含 100 名学生、1,248 次会谈的开放中文校园心理咨询数据集 CPCD。
en_tdlr: Psy-Chronicle is an event-driven framework that synthesizes multi-session counseling dialogues grounded in simulated students' semester timelines, yielding CPCD, an open Chinese dataset of 100 students and 1,248 sessions spanning a full semester.
